answers.explanation: Grouping by the kind of device or role is a layout by function.
If 10.2.0.0/16 is the warehouse, the warehouse router can advertise just 10.2.0.0/16 instead of dozens of small routes.
By location, everyone on a floor shares a subnet, so location alone doesn't separate people or devices by trust.
A project's machines are walled off together and can be cleaned up together.
The second octet is the site, so 10.2.40.5 is site 2 (the warehouse in the example), function 40 (cameras), host 5.
Mixing them gets the routing benefits of location and the security benefits of function.
Devices with the same job need the same rules, so grouping by function keeps the rules simple.
